findings.obs_text: In Act 19:9 stubborn (G4645) stands twelve words before reasoning: some hearers harden, and that is the first of the causes that move Paul to withdraw and reason elsewhere.
In Act 24:25 judgment (G2917) stands seven words after reasoned and is the third subject of the reasoning, the judgment to come.

In Jam 3:17 wisdom (G4678) opens the verse as the subject that open to reason describes: open to reason is a quality of the wisdom from above. WordNet relates the subgroup to this collection through understanding and reasonableness, synonyms; the verse joins reason to wisdom as one of its qualities.
